sources.name: Estes Park Events Complex (Town of Estes Park Events Division)
sources.defaultVenue: Estes Park Events Complex, 1125 Rooftop Way
sources.notes: Fetched 6 October 2026. estesparkeventscomplex.com is the Town's events site (footer: 'Town of Estes Park Events Division', 1125 Rooftop Way, 970-577-3900, events@estes.org); its canonical host is eventsinestes.com (WordPress/Elementor, Jetpack). The home page lists the Town's signature events by month (First Peoples Festival in January, Wine & Chocolate Festival in February, Whiskey Warm Up in March, and so on). The /calendar/ page is an embedded Google Calendar, id estes.org_crkjvme9sv81j4b73v1ctelmfs@group.calendar.google.com, time zone America/Denver; calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows agents, so the id is recorded and not read. Dead ends: /events/?ical=1 returned the HTML events page, not iCal (The Events Calendar is not installed); /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events returned 404. The site's WordPress post feed https://eventsinestes.com/feed/ was read once: RSS, 10 items, all posts dated 3 February 2026 describing fiber-arts classes (Scandinavian Skinnfells, Botanical Printing, Spin the Yarn You Need), so it is a stale class listing, not an events feed. Manual until the Town shares an iCal of the Google calendar or the owner approves a Google Calendar read. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Visit Estes Park events calendar
sources.notes: Fetched 6 October 2026. Simpleview CMS destination site (the local marketing district, not the Town). /events/ redirects to /events-calendar/, with sub-listings /this-weekend/, /by-month/, /community-events/, /events-calendar/live-music/, seasonal pages (/winter-events/, /estes-park-skijor/, /frozen-dead-guy-days/) and /submit-event/. The RSS feed /event/rss/ was read once: application/rss+xml, 30 items; sample titles 'Pots and Paint', 'Bella Metz', 'Board Game Night at The Legion', 'Chocolate Bar Making Experience', 'Clay Class: Coil or Pebble Bowls', 'Intro to Stained Glass Workshop', 'Mini Clay Wheel Workshop', 'Morning Yoga'; item dates were all 'Mon, 05 Oct 2026 23:59:59 -0600' (Mountain time, apparently the event day rather than a publish time), so the feed looks like a rolling window of the next days' events, heavy on paid classes and recurring activities; locations were not shown by the helper's summary and need checking on first ingest. Not meetings. Not confirmed, 6 October 2026: the feed is the local marketing district’s listings calendar, which takes event submissions from businesses (/submit-event/), not an organizer’s own calendar. The official sources it would stand in for are the Town’s Events Division (eventsinestes-com, read by hand), the library (estesvalleylibrary-org) and the venues themselves.

No RSS or iCal link was present in the page HTML (only the WordPress post feed https://esteschamber.org/feed/, not read), so the entry stays html until GrowthZone's feed URL is confirmed with the chamber. Also hosts 'Red Ribbon Cuttings', the Ready Set Grow conference and Women of Impact awards, and the economic development pages. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Visit Estes Park / Estes Park Visitor Center
sources.notes: Fetched 6 October 2026 (HTTP 200, 367 KB; only the navigation text was captured, so the address and hours still need to be read by a person). Filed under chamber because the registry has no visitor-center category. The Town itself runs the Estes Park Visitor Center (linked from eventsinestes.com as https://estespark.colorado.gov/visitorservices, which returned 403 here); Visit Estes Park is the destination marketing organization whose site also carries RMNP visitor information, the visitor guide, free shuttle and parking pages, web cams, 'Fire Info' and 'Construction Updates' pages, and the RMNP Timed Entry Permit page. Reference source for lodging, visitor-center and getting-around facts rather than events (events come from the visitestespark-com entry). Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Estes Valley Library
sources.notes: Fetched 6 October 2026. estesvalleylibrary.org is WordPress (hours on the home page: Monday-Thursday 10 AM-8 PM, Friday and Saturday 10 AM-6 PM, Sunday 1 PM-5 PM); its events run on Springshare LibCal at calendar.estesvalleylibrary.org. The LibCal page offers 'subscribe to this calendar' (ical_subscribe.php?src=p, cid 19315 taken from the page's RSS link) and the iCal was read once: text/calendar, 225 VEVENT, 0 RRULE, dates 2026-09-05 to 2027-09-06; sample titles 'Teen Maker Mornings - Button/Magnet Making', 'Baby Storytime at Cubz Den Recreation Center', 'Saturday Science Kids Club', 'Teen Dungeons & Dragons', 'Writing the Nightmare ... with Daniel Kraus', 'Tween Dragon Slayers'; locations 'Makerspace', 'Estes Valley Community Center', 'Alteatude', 'Library-wide'. Not meetings. Some items are closures or display notes ('Library Closed - Labor Day', 'Fall Sign', 'Makerspace Guide'), hence excludeTitles. Time zone handling was not shown by the helper's summary; check DTSTART/TZID on first ingest. The month RSS https://calendar.estesvalleylibrary.org/rss.php?iid=6313&m=month&cid=19315 was also read once (62 items) and is an alternative. Storytimes are held off-site at the Cubz Den / Estes Valley Community Center (EVRPD), so the defaultVenue should only apply when LOCATION is empty. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Rocky Mountain National Park
sources.notes: Fetched 6 October 2026. Land agency, filed under parks. The calendar page /romo/planyourvisit/calendar.htm (HTTP 200, 36 KB) is rendered client-side by the NPS 'nps-calendar' widget and exposes no RSS or iCal link; ranger programs would have to come from the NPS Events API at developer.nps.gov, which needs an API key (recorded, not called). Conditions page /romo/planyourvisit/conditions.htm (HTTP 200) links to Park Roads /romo/planyourvisit/road_status.htm, Trail Conditions /romo/planyourvisit/trail_conditions.htm, Area Closures /romo/planyourvisit/area_closures.htm and /romo/raptor-closures.htm. The Park Roads page (HTTP 200) is where Trail Ridge Road status is published; on 6 October it read 'Trail Ridge Road (U.S. Highway 34 inside Rocky Mountain National Park) is Open to Through Travel', 'Timed Entry Reservations are required for Trail Ridge Road from 9 am to 2 pm', recorded status line 970-586-1222, and Bear Lake Road open year-round. Dead end: /romo/planyourvisit/trail_ridge_road_status.htm returned 404, so link road_status.htm instead. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).
